purpose: Offline preparation for human bilingual review; not a benchmark score or a live evaluation harness.
offsetConvention: zero-based UTF-16 code units; end exclusive; exact unnormalized original sentence
limitations: All source sentences and meaning hints are AI-authored drafts, not independently reviewed ground truth.

The original 38 source probes have two or three candidates per source language; 15 additional Russian-source reverse-target probes cover the other target directions. These are smoke-test candidates, not evidence of fluent quality or population accuracy.

Target glosses, where present, are nonexhaustive tentative hints, not exact-string assertions; distinct possible senses must remain separate. Reverse-target probes deliberately supply no target-language glosses pending bilingual review.
Learner levels are requested test conditions, not validated CEFR labels for these sentences.
Pronunciation, audio, dialect suitability, learning outcomes, provider behavior, cost and latency have not been measured.
No personal data, external requests, API credentials, provider responses or paid-run code are included.
The 53 cases cover 36 directed pairs, not the full 17-by-17 pair space. Target-language correctness and script/grammar handling remain unmeasured.
